user.title: Sign in to Yard Mastery
user.description: Use the email and password of your Yard Mastery account. This is an unofficial integration.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Yard Mastery again
reauth_confirm.description: Yard Mastery no longer accepts the stored password for {email}. Enter the current password.

error.invalid_auth: Yard Mastery rejected the email or password.

abort.already_configured: This Yard Mastery account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: You signed in with a different Yard Mastery account. Use the account this entry was set up with.

data_description.allow_writes: When off, every action that would change your Yard Mastery data is refused.
data_description.app_version: Yard Mastery rejects app versions it has retired. Set a newer version here if a repair tells you so.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to check Yard Mastery, from 15 to 1440 minutes.

app_version_invalid.title: Yard Mastery app version was retired
app_version_invalid.description: Yard Mastery app version {version} was retired and the service may stop answering. Set a newer version under the integration's options.

log_application.name: Log application
log_application.description: Log products applied on a date in the Yard Mastery journal, merging with any entry already there. Without products, logs the window's items that are not done yet at their recommended amount for your lawn and marks them done (experimental).

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The Yard Mastery entry to use. Only needed when several accounts are set up.

products.name: Products
products.description: List of {product, amount}: product name or id, and the total amount you spread over the lawn (as the app records it). Without amount, the recommended rate times your lawn size is used.

window.name: Window
window.description: Window whose open items are logged when no products are given: current (default), next, a window name or its start date.

areas.name: Areas
areas.description: Lawn areas (segment names) to record on the entry.

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: Text appended to the entry's notes.

set_item_status.name: Set program item status
set_item_status.description: Mark program items done, skipped or not done.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The Yard Mastery entry to use. Only needed when several accounts are set up.

items.name: Item IDs
items.description: Program item ids (any window). Not combined with products or window.

products.name: Products
products.description: Product names of items in the window.

window.name: Window
window.description: current (default), next, a window name or its start date (YYYY-MM-DD).

config_entry_id.name: Account

file.name: File
file.description: Path of a JPEG under /config or /media. The folder must also be in Home Assistant's allowlist_external_dirs (by default /config/www and the media folders).

entity_id.name: Camera or image
entity_id.description: Take the photo from this camera or image entity instead of a file.

delete_journal_entry.name: Delete journal entry
delete_journal_entry.description: Delete the Yard Mastery journal entry for a date, or by id. Give one of the two.
